symbols.reasoning: Fetches Pending jobs once, then processes each in server-returned order with a cancellation check before each. It trusts route filtering/order from server rather than sorting or claiming itself. A snapshot can become stale or be concurrently drained by another machine. Return count counts attempted ProcessAsync completions, not physical successes.

symbols.reasoning: If journal already has job outcome, only re-report it. Otherwise mint one attempt ID, fetch/map/render ticket, persist uncertain outcome before bytes leave, send, then persist observed success/failure and report using same key. Cancellation during send leaves uncertain record for later manual reconciliation. This prevents ordinary same-station report-failure reprints but cannot fence other machines.
symbols.outputs: Task completion; reported success/failure or exception
symbols.side_effects: HTTP fetch/report, local durable journal, actual selected transport output if run
